title: Aai Aai Ya Karoon Mai Kya
Khoon Bhari Maang
desc: Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth but she survives and seeks revenge.

title: Naseeb Apna Apna
desc: A naive village girl marries the son of a domineering man. However, upon her arrival at his house in the city, she finds out that he is already married.

title: Phool Aur Angaar
desc: A young man rescues a woman from being molested but gets accused of the heinous crime instead. Trying to apprehend the miscreants, he gets caught in a web of deception and lies.

title: Aaj Ka Arjun
desc: A ruthless landlord exiles Bheema due to his rebellion against him. However, when his nephew is abducted, Bheema sets out to gain the support of the villagers and rescue the boy.

title: Toofan
desc: Separated at birth, the paths of Shyam, a lousy magician unwittingly roped into a crime, and Toofan, a defender of the people, cross again years later as they reunite to avenge their father.
